topic: Hand off a real task: turn rough notes into a slide deck with Cowork
post:
Got a presentation due and only messy notes? 📝
Here's how I'd hand that whole job to Claude Cowork.

Quick reminder: Cowork is the part of Claude that does whole tasks for you, not just answers. Making slide decks from rough notes or meeting transcripts is one of the examples in Claude's own help guide.

Step by step 👇

1️⃣ Open Claude (web, desktop or mobile app)
2️⃣ In the message box, select "Cowork"
3️⃣ Add your notes and describe the result you want
4️⃣ Review Claude's approach, then let it run

Here's a prompt you can copy:
"Turn my attached meeting notes into a 6-slide deck for my team. One idea per slide, short bullets, a clear title on each. End with a slide of next steps and owners. If something in the notes is unclear, list it on a final 'Open questions' slide instead of guessing."

Then open the deck and edit anything that isn't quite right. 🎯

Good to know: Cowork is on paid plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise). Working with files on your computer needs the Claude desktop app.

Why it matters:
The blank-slide stage is often the slowest part. Hand off the first draft, and spend your time on the story. ✨

What's a deck you'd hand off first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
